status: Frozen recovery-only typed codex-mcp integration; no Rust/fmt/tests executed
lower_prerequisite: codex_rmcp_client exports McpShutdownConfirmation::{Confirmed,Unconfirmed}, McpShutdownFailure::{Service,Transport,Process,Task,Closed}; RmcpClient::shutdown returns Result<Confirmation,Failure>. Lower lifecycle owners retain exact resources/outcomes independently.
contracts: ConnectionShutdownOutcome custom RetainedTaskOutcome succeeds only on Confirmed; Unconfirmed and known errors remain globally reachable after connection-set observers leave.

Connection snapshot attempts each nonpanicking connection shutdown; known lower failure wins over any confirmations, Unconfirmed wins over Confirmed. A join panic/cancellation maps to Task and original JoinError stays with RetainedTask.
AsyncManagedClient startup cancellation/error returns Unconfirmed; startup failure is not automatically a cleanup error and cannot prove partial resources closed.

McpRuntime::shutdown propagates known lower failures while ordinary Ok(Unconfirmed) remains nonfatal. Exact confirmation is stored by the connection owner before returning and is separately queryable.
latest_shutdown_confirmation returns Option<Result<Confirmation,Failure>> for CURRENT snapshot only. None is not confirmed; Unconfirmed is never a whole-host clean receipt.
Auth invalidation caller explicitly distinguishes Confirmed, retained Unconfirmed, and known failure; it emits no successful cleanup receipt from an Unconfirmed outcome.
tests: Two new unexecuted behavioral regressions: dropped-manager Unconfirmed exact task remains primary-reachable; Confirmed empty snapshot retires after exact join. Existing panic test now expects bounded Task error. Existing lower client shutdown tests consume typed Result.
limits: No core changes or new process-final receipt/aggregate in this revision.
Getter excludes earlier and partially constructed connection snapshots; full per-session/process-final proof still needs scoped generation roster observation.
Lower HTTP private-worker confirmation and descendant-group proof remain bounded by the lower implementation/pinned SDK; no stronger guarantee from this adaptation.
Auth watcher is best effort; known shutdown errors are logged as bounded categories and remain retained by lower lifecycle owners for later observation.

A panic during one connection shutdown terminates the snapshot task, so remaining entries are not all observed on that path. Immutable Task failure prevents a false clean result; independent lower registries retain resources.
dependency_impact: No Cargo or Bazel dependency changes from these nine codex-mcp files; lower rmcp-client proposal has separate dependency/accounting responsibility.
